## Rules for Contributors (author's note)

### Who can become a Contributor
* Anyone willing to learn about the EVM infrastructure.
* Anyone who sees a potential in this project and has the expertize to improve it.

### LLM USAGE
* The contributors are to take complete responsibility of the code they submit, so it is expected that you review the code (if generated by an LLM) before opening an **issue** or submiting a **pull request**.
* People / Bots, spamming the repository with LLM generated content will be **banned**.
* Always acknowledge the use of a LLMs (if used) in the **pull requests** submitted or **issues** opened.
